close_col = [c for c in cols if '收盘价' in c][0]
vol_col = [c for c in cols if '成交量' in c][0]

px = df_px[['date', close_col, vol_col]].copy()
px['date'] = pd.to_datetime(px['date'])
px = px.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
px.rename(columns={close_col:'close', vol_col:'volume'}, inplace=True)

# 计算均线
for n in [5,10,20,60]:
    px[f'MA{n}'] = px['close'].rolling(n).mean()

# MACD(12,26,9)
ema12 = px['close'].ewm(span=12, adjust=False).mean()
ema26 = px['close'].ewm(span=26, adjust=False).mean()
px['DIF'] = ema12 - ema26
px['DEA'] = px['DIF'].ewm(span=9, adjust=False).mean()
px['MACD'] = (px['DIF'] - px['DEA']) * 2

# RSI(14)
delta = px['close'].diff()
gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
loss = (-delta).clip(lower=0)
avg_gain = gain.rolling(14).mean()
avg_loss = loss.rolling(14).mean()
rs = avg_gain / avg_loss
px['RSI14'] = 100 - (100/(1+rs))

# 最近一个交易日快照
last_date = px.index.max()
snapshot = px.loc[last_date, ['close','volume','MA5','MA10','MA20','MA60','DIF','DEA','MACD','RSI14']].to_frame('value')

# 近20日高低点（用于短线压力/支撑）

})

snapshot, summary, px.tail(10)"
